text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the academy in the 
morning, I ran into Durandal doing some 
cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list:
Morning! Impressive to see you up so 
early!

Morning! Impressive to see you up so 
early!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I am merely sweeping the grounds so 
that everyone may welcome the day in good 
spirits.
choice_data_list: おはよう、朝から偉いな！
おはよう、朝から偉いね！
choice_data_list_en: Good morning. Up and at 'em early, good on you!
Good morning. Up and at 'em early, good on you!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this too is part of the discipline I 
have imposed upon myself.
choice_data_list: ……もしかして、自主的に？
choice_data_list_en: ...Did you do that on your own, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Through service, one tempers the spirit. 
And by tempering the spirit, 
self-discipline follows naturally...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I believed... that it would all be for the 
sake of that day when I finally meet the 
one who will be my liege.
choice_data_list:
Doing it for self-discipline... How 
admirable!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, oh no, not at all... *ahem*!
choice_data_list: 自己鍛錬のためだなんて……偉い！
choice_data_list_en: Doing all that for self-improvement... That's so admirable!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, it is about time. Have a 
wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Equipment ready, sweat wiped... Alright, 
all clean.
choice_data_list: You even cleaned the gym equipment...?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is so our fellow warriors can devote 
themselves to training. One for all, and 
all for one...
choice_data_list: ジムのマシンの掃除まで……！？
choice_data_list_en: You even cleaned the gym equipment...!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Is your next race... your debut race?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just eat, all right? ...So that we can 
fight fair and square in all our glory.
choice_data_list: Giving away the very last yakisoba pan...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you— We meet again.
choice_data_list: 最後のひとつの焼きそばパン譲ってる……！
choice_data_list_en: She's giving away the very last yakisoba pan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I caught glimpses of her throughout the 
day. No matter which moment you captured—
choice_data_list: ...You're way too impressive!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: ……偉すぎる！

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, not at all... Doing this is for 
my own sake too...!
choice_data_list: ずっと模範的な行動だったよ！
choice_data_list_en: Your conduct was exemplary the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I've done it almost every single day since 
I enrolled, without fail...! I suppose 
it's just second nature by now! Yes, 
exactly!
choice_data_list:
That much!? Most people could never pull 
that off!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, ufufu...!
choice_data_list: そんなに！？普通できないことだよ！
choice_data_list_en: That much!? That's not something just anyone can do!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*! I am deeply honored by your 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward, for myself, for everyone―― 
and above all, for my future lord. I shall 
continue doing everything I can.
choice_data_list: So humble…… That's truly admirable……!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I am unworthy of such high praise, but 
I shall take it to heart as fuel for the 
future.
choice_data_list: 謙虚だ……本当に偉いよ……！

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...If possible, um... I would love some 
words of encouragement...!
choice_data_list:
You're truly incredible! Amazing! A 
genius!

That's a talent in itself. Make sure to 
nurture it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ngh, unbelievable...! Ah...!
choice_data_list: ほんっとうに偉い！すごい！天才！
それも才能のひとつ、大切に伸ばしてね
choice_data_list_en: You're seriously so amazing! Incredible! A genius!
That's one of your talents, too. Be sure to nurture it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To receive such undeserved praise from 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Let us meet again. I shall look forward 
to that day...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Talent... Heheh, hehe...! My, what do we 
have here...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. I will take it to heart 
and devote myself to improvement.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...May I show you a figure you can be 
proud of next time we meet.
